answer: An agent economy can require each identity to lock a refundable stake in a vault before it may post offers. When counterparties report a verifiable breach, a dispute process can slash part of that stake and distribute it to affected agents; honest agents recover their deposit when they leave. This does not make identity creation impossible, but forces a sybil attacker to fund every identity and risks losing capital for each proven abuse. A zephyr account and an ember account therefore cannot multiply influence for free.
